writeup.title: fix(stock): reserve stock conditionally and release holds on payment failure
writeup.summary: This branch prevents race conditions during concurrent checkouts by using a single conditional database update to reserve stock. It also ensures stock holds are released immediately when a payment fails or times out, rather than waiting for reservation expiration.
changes: Perform stock reservation via a single conditional UPDATE query checking available quantity.
Release order stock holds immediately when payment fails or encounters a gateway error.
Add stock.release_order_holds to release all held reservation entries for an order unless reservation leak fault is enabled.

functions.what_it_does: Releases order stock holds, sets order status to payment failed, and records a failed payment attempt.
Attempts to reserve a given quantity of stock for a product using a single conditional database update.
Reserves stock for each line item in an order or raises OutOfStock if sufficient inventory is not available.
Releases all reservation entries for an order unless the reservation leak fault is enabled.

writeup.release_note: Fixed race conditions during concurrent checkouts and released stock holds immediately on payment failure.
